entries.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.

intro.zh: DeepSeek 开源的 Agent 运行框架，命令行叫 dsh，核心思路是「一切皆插件」——Agent 的能力都由插件拼装，底层用 Cordis 做组合。装好 Node.js 后一条 npm 命令就能起本地 Web 界面，在浏览器里和 Agent 交互。目前是开发者预览版，官方提醒会有破坏性兼容变更。
intro.en: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness, run from the command line as dsh, built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis. Install Node.js, run one npm command, and a local Web UI opens in your browser. It's a developer preview, and the project warns that compatibility-breaking changes will happen.

cardLine.zh: DeepSeek 开源的 Agent 运行框架，一切皆插件，自带 Web 界面
cardLine.en: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness where everything is a plugin

entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

intro.zh: 给 AI Agent 装上「屋里最懒的资深工程师」思维：动手前先问一句，这段代码真的需要存在吗。装上后，Agent 更倾向用最少代码解决问题——比如日期选择器直接上原生输入控件，而不是装组件库再写包装层。作为 Claude Code 等编码 Agent 的技能安装即用。
intro.en: A skill that gives your AI agent the instincts of the laziest senior dev in the room: before writing anything, ask whether the code needs to exist at all. With it, your agent reaches for a native input instead of installing a component library and a wrapper. Installs as a skill for coding agents like Claude Code.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI Agent 少写代码的编码技能，逼它先问「真需要吗」
cardLine.en: A coding skill that makes your agent write less code

entries.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

intro.zh: Orca 是一个为「多 Agent 并行」准备的 ADE：把 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 同时跑起来，每个 agent 独占一个 git worktree，再统一在一处查看。除了桌面端，它还有手机端和远程运行时，agent 干完活会通知你，你也能随时补一条后续指令。典型场景是把同一个提示词分给几个 agent 比稿，挑最好的那个合并。
intro.en: Orca is an ADE for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel: launch Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own git worktree, and track them all in one place. Beyond the desktop app it offers a mobile companion and a remote runtime, so you get notified when an agent finishes and can send follow-ups from anywhere. The typical use case is fanning one prompt across several agents and merging the winner.

cardLine.zh: 多 agent 并行的 ADE：每个编码 agent 独占一个 worktree，桌面、手机、远程都能用。
cardLine.en: An ADE for parallel agents: each coding agent gets its own worktree, managed from desktop, phone or remote.

entries.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

intro.zh: 一套给编码 Agent 用的工程体系：让 Agent 先规划再动手、用测试验证改动、换个干净上下文自查、记住关键信息，并把反复奏效的做法沉淀成可复用技能。装一次就融进日常流程，不用在每个提示词里重复交代。目前对 Claude Code 支持最好，也为 Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等提供适配。

cardLine.zh: 给编码 Agent 装上规划、记忆、自审与安全扫描的工程化体系

Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors

intro.zh: 一个 MIT 协议的开源 AI 网关：对外只暴露一个接口，背后接上几百家模型服务商，其中不少带免费额度。它会按剩余配额自动切换供应商，让你在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具里尽量不中断地继续写代码。还内置 token 压缩、MCP/A2A 支持和桌面 / PWA 形态。
intro.en: An MIT-licensed AI gateway that puts hundreds of model providers behind a single endpoint, many of them with free tiers. It falls back based on remaining quota so you keep coding in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar tools. Also bundles token compression, MCP/A2A support, and desktop/PWA clients.

cardLine.zh: 开源 AI 网关，一个接口接入数百家模型服务并自动切换配额
cardLine.en: Open-source gateway to hundreds of model providers, one endpoint

entries.name: pi

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 430 star（日均约 61，相对存量增速 0.4%），累计 104,952 star、13,174 fork。
why.en: Gained 430 stars over the last 7 days (~61/day, 0.4% of its base), now at 104,952 stars and 13,174 forks.

highlights.zh: 统一的 LLM API 把 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多家 provider 收在一层接口后面。
highlights.en: A unified LLM API puts OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other providers behind one interface.

highlights.zh: pi-agent-core 提供带工具调用和状态管理的 agent 运行时，可以直接嵌进自己的应用。
highlights.en: pi-agent-core gives you an agent runtime with tool calling and state management that you can embed in your own app.

highlights.zh: 编码 agent CLI 可自我扩展，还有带差分渲染的终端 UI 库撑起界面。
highlights.en: A self-extensible coding agent CLI, backed by a terminal UI library with differential rendering.

highlights.zh: 权限边界交给容器：文档给了 Gondolin 扩展、普通 Docker、OpenShell 沙箱三种隔离模式。
highlights.en: Boundaries are left to containers: the docs cover three isolation patterns — the Gondolin extension, plain Docker, and the OpenShell sandbox.

cons.zh: 未声明开源许可证，商用存在法务不确定性
cons.en: No open-source license declared — legal uncertainty for commercial use

cons.zh: 缺少官网与文档入口，上手成本较高
cons.en: No homepage or docs site — steeper onboarding

fitFor.zh: 关注 AI Agent 生态、想快速了解新项目的从业者
fitFor.en: Practitioners tracking the AI agent ecosystem

entries.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI

intro.zh: Pi 是一套 AI agent 工具包，里面有统一的 LLM API（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多家）、带工具调用和状态管理的 agent 运行时、终端 UI 库，以及一个可自我扩展的交互式编码 agent CLI。想自己拼一个 agent 而不是只用现成产品，可以按需挑包组合。需要注意它没有内置权限系统，默认以启动它的用户权限运行，要边界就自己容器化。
intro.en: Pi is an AI agent toolkit bundling a unified multi-provider LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more), an agent runtime with tool calling and state management, a terminal UI library, and a self-extensible interactive coding agent CLI. If you'd rather assemble an agent than adopt a finished product, you can pick just the packages you need. Note there is no built-in permission system — Pi runs with the permissions of whoever launched it, so containerize or sandbox it if you need hard boundaries.

cardLine.zh: AI agent 工具包：统一 LLM API、agent 运行时、TUI 库和可扩展的编码 agent CLI。
cardLine.en: An AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent runtime, TUI library and an extensible coding agent CLI.
